title: Fix agentic router context delivery
body:
Bot mention routing can stop with `missing_data` because the prompt requires `router-context.json`, but the router has no tool that can read it. This left [run 34882512561](https://github.com/remix-run/react-router/actions/runs/34882512561) green without dispatching a command workflow.

Compute the target type and Discussion category during activation and interpolate them directly into the prompt. Preserve the existing tool restrictions and safe-output validation, and regenerate the workflow lock.

**Testing**

- Strict gh-aw compilation with validation passed without errors or warnings.
- Local checks confirmed metadata availability before prompt interpolation for issues, PRs, Proposal Discussions, other Discussions, missing categories, and untrusted category text. The original workflow fails the metadata-availability check.
- Live routing and downstream dispatch remain unverified; they need a new bot mention after the fix lands.
